description:
Enhance BigQuery DDL generation to fully utilize the tuning configuration
system with support for partitioning, clustering, and BigQuery-specific features.

## BigQuery Physical Tuning Features

### Time-based Partitioning
```sql
CREATE TABLE t (...) PARTITION BY DATE(timestamp_col);
CREATE TABLE t (...) PARTITION BY DATETIME_TRUNC(datetime_col, DAY);
CREATE TABLE t (...) PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC(date_col, MONTH);
```

### Integer Range Partitioning
```sql
CREATE TABLE t (...)
PARTITION BY RANGE_BUCKET(int_col, GENERATE_ARRAY(0, 100, 10));
```

### Clustering (up to 4 columns)
```sql
CREATE TABLE t (...) CLUSTER BY col1, col2, col3, col4;
```

### Require Partition Filter
Prevents expensive full-table scans:
```sql
CREATE TABLE t (...)
PARTITION BY DATE(ts)
OPTIONS (require_partition_filter = true);
```

## Current State

BigQuery adapter (`benchbox/platforms/bigquery.py`) has:
- Inline PARTITION BY in `_create_table_statement()` (line ~1292)
- Inline CLUSTER BY (line ~1295)
- `generate_tuning_clause()` method (line ~1473)
- Uses adapter config (partitioning_field), not tuning YAML
